description.value: The Art Gallery of Greater Victoria is anchored by a striking 1889 Victorian mansion alongside seven modern galleries, holding the largest public art collection in British Columbia — over 22,000 works — including the most significant collection of Asian art in Western Canada. Founded in 1951 when the Spencer Mansion was donated to the city, the AGGV is a genuine landmark in Victoria's Rockland neighbourhood and a draw for visitors from across the island and beyond. Cyclists will find it a culturally rich stop, with free admission days and a coat-room locker area where large bags can be safely stored.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and is clearly current (2026 exhibitions listed), confirming the gallery is open and active. The /about/visit/ subpage explicitly describes free locker storage ('Free Lockers — We have several lockers with keys in our coat room. You are welcome to store your personal belongings in these while you browse the Gallery'), which supports a true value for luggage/bag storage. No mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, cafe, showers, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Cyclists with large panniers or bags should be aware that bags over 12″ × 12″ × 9″ are not permitted in exhibition spaces; free lockers are available but this may affect the visitor experience for loaded touring cyclists.
No bike parking infrastructure (racks, covered parking) is mentioned on the website; on-site bike parking status is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The AGGV is the largest public art gallery on Vancouver Island and a well-established Victoria cultural landmark; a touring cyclist visiting the city would clearly benefit from this listing, and the free locker storage is a practical amenity for cyclists with gear.

Luggage / bag storage.detail: Free lockers with keys in the coat room available to all visitors for storing personal belongings while browsing the Gallery. Note: bags larger than 12″ × 12″ × 9″ are prohibited in exhibition spaces (except medical/first aid), so cyclists with large panniers would need to use these lockers

wow_evidence: Largest public art collection in BC (22,000+ works), most significant Asian collection in western Canada, 1889 Spencer Mansion — provincial-tier gallery; a notch below MOA's delight.
blurb: BC's largest public art collection, anchored by an 1889 mansion.
